assessments.reasoning: Section 3.4(b) performs dictionary lookup before step (c)'s number conversion, which is reached if no matching definition exists. If conversion succeeds, the interpretation state puts the number on the data stack. The compilation state appends logic which produces the value at run time.

challenge.method: Traced the dictionary-hit, lookup-miss/successful-number, and lookup-miss/invalid-number branches. Checked the state distinction and scope of the nearby parsing clause.
challenge.results: A dictionary hit uses the matching word's respective semantics. Only a failed lookup leads to numeric conversion. An unsuccessful conversion creates an ambiguous condition, and compilation records delayed behavior.

limitations: The draft supplies a separate ambiguous condition if neither lookup nor conversion succeeds. This finding does not specify optional number syntax or behavior after that condition.
